mechanism: Propylthiouracil may cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, which could potentiate risedronate-associated jaw complications and impair healing; additionally, untreated hyperthyroidism increases bone turnover, potentially reducing risedronate efficacy.
action: Monitor complete blood counts regularly during PTU therapy; ensure adequate disease control before bisphosphonate therapy; assess for osteonecrosis of jaw risk and maintain excellent oral hygiene.
